text_block_list.text:
One day, a magazine interview request came 
in for Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, how does it look? Is my skirt 
wrinkled or anything?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wearing my racing silks outside of a race 
feels kind of strange.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Even though I'm not the one running, it 
gets me all fired up, or should I say... 
it really gets my blood pumping~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I understand how you feel. After all, 
putting on your racing silks is when 
things get serious."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I just naturally get all serious!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I hope I don't make a weird face during 
the interview from being too serious...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
By the way, I wonder if the others aren't 
here yet? Sei-chan, Grass-chan, and 
El-chan.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
We still have plenty of time. It's just 
that we arrived too early.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I got so restless that I just 
couldn't sit still anymore.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You're the star, so stand tall and 
composed. Look at King's magnificent 
poise!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Did you get restless and come early 
too, King-chan?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that's not true! It's not like King 
got so carried away that she got the time 
wrong or anything!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, first is the photoshoot, and the 
interview comes after that, right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I've heard that, but... uuugh, photo 
shoots still make me so nervous.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I still don't really know what kind of 
pose I should strike.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
What if I'm the only one dressed up 
weird...?
choice_data_list: Just let all that burning passion out.

Maybe a pose that shows you're conscious 
of your rival would be good

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: A burning passion... you say?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You said it yourself earlier, didn't you? 
That putting on your racing silks fires 
you up.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see! I just have to express this 
feeling I get when I wear my racewear!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A true contest needs no decoration. A 
match is all about giving every last drop 
of what you've got, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll let out all these burning, 
sizzling feelings straight from the heart!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Conscious of her rivals...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what is it... staring right at me like 
that.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I wanted to see King-chan's pose.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I didn't tell you to copy your rival, I 
told you to show the spirit of refusing to 
lose!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah! So that's what it was!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The feeling of refusing to lose to my 
rivals... Yeah, I'll just pour that right 
out there!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Still, this Racewear really is special 
after all. It makes the desire to win just 
keep welling up inside me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
They're all precious friends of mine, but 
they're rivals too, so I'm going to run 
with everything I've got and win for sure!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
O-ho-ho-ho! Challenge accepted! And I'm 
sure the other three would say the same.
choice_data_list:
Let's keep pushing each other to greater 
heights as rivals!

Let's keep pushing each other to greater 
heights as rivals!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Today is a photoshoot, but next time, 
I'll be out on the turf with everyone in 
this outfit!
